# Error codes

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:generate` from packages/contracts/src/errors/codes.ts. Do not edit. -->

Every API error uses the envelope from plan 17 §2. Clients branch on `code`;
`message` is a default text that may change.

| Code | HTTP | Retryable | Meaning |
| ---- | ---- | --------- | ------- |
| `unauthenticated` | 401 | no | Sign in required. |
| `session_unbound` | 401 | no | Bind this browser session to its key first. |
| `session_already_bound` | 409 | no | This session is already bound to a key. |
| `token_invalid` | 401 | no | Invalid or expired access token. |
| `refresh_invalid` | 401 | no | Invalid refresh token. |
| `refresh_reused` | 401 | no | Refresh token reuse detected; this device was revoked. |
| `device_revoked` | 401 | no | This device was revoked. |
| `device_suspended` | 403 | no | This device is suspended. |
| `account_suspended` | 403 | no | This account is suspended. |
| `dpop_invalid` | 401 | no | Invalid proof of possession. |
| `dpop_nonce_required` | 401 | yes | Retry with the server nonce. |
| `dpop_replay` | 401 | no | Proof of possession was replayed. |
| `signature_invalid` | 401 | no | Request signature is invalid. |
| `csrf_rejected` | 403 | no | Cross-site request rejected. |
| `step_up_required` | 403 | no | Sign in again to continue. |
| `forbidden` | 403 | no | Not allowed. |
| `cli_auth_expired` | 410 | no | This login request expired. |
| `cli_auth_denied` | 403 | no | This login request was denied. |
| `cli_auth_final` | 409 | no | This login request was already handled. |
| `pkce_invalid` | 401 | no | PKCE verification failed. |
| `roster_exists` | 409 | no | This account is already initialized. |
| `roster_missing` | 409 | no | Finish account setup in the browser first. |
| `roster_conflict` | 409 | yes | The roster changed; fetch it and retry. |
| `roster_invalid` | 422 | no | Roster statement is malformed. |
| `member_inactive` | 403 | no | The signing member is not an active member. |
| `key_gen_invalid` | 422 | no | Invalid key generation. |
| `join_request_closed` | 409 | no | This join request is no longer open. |
| `not_found` | 404 | no | Not found. |
| `pouch_limit_reached` | 403 | no | Pouch limit reached for your plan. |
| `pouch_read_only` | 409 | no | This pouch is read-only. |
| `quota_exceeded` | 413 | no | Storage quota exceeded. |
| `precondition_failed` | 412 | no | Base revision is out of date. |
| `epoch_mismatch` | 409 | no | Server restored; rebase required. |
| `cursor_expired` | 410 | no | History expired; rebase required. |
| `operation_id_reused` | 409 | no | Operation ID reused with a different body. |
| `blob_missing` | 422 | no | Referenced blob not uploaded. |
| `blob_too_large` | 413 | no | Blob exceeds the size limit. |
| `ciphertext_hash_mismatch` | 422 | yes | Upload corrupted in transit. |
| `envelope_invalid` | 422 | no | Encrypted payload is malformed. |
| `snapshot_expired` | 410 | no | Snapshot lease expired; start again. |
| `billing_unavailable` | 503 | no | Billing is not configured. |
| `webhook_invalid` | 401 | no | Webhook signature invalid. |
| `last_admin` | 409 | no | The last admin cannot be demoted. |
| `validation_failed` | 400 | no | Invalid request. |
| `payload_too_large` | 413 | no | Request body too large. |
| `rate_limited` | 429 | yes | Too many requests. |
| `maintenance_write_pause` | 503 | yes | Brief maintenance, retrying. |
| `internal_error` | 500 | yes | Something went wrong. |
